meta.description: Turns paths into the surface around them with a fibrous relief along them. Every node that made paths is its own material group, grown hyphae are grouped by tissue.

hyphae.label: Body
hyphae.description: Paths that grow into one body of tissue, like stipe and cap: the gaps between them fill

loose.label: Loose
loose.description: Paths that stay apart, like gills and the veil: they join where they touch, the gaps between them stay open

fibres.description: Relief along the paths, fibrous on the body, faint on loose paths

blend.description: How far, in path radii, neighbouring paths join into one surface

fill.description: Where a ball of this many path radii can't pass between body paths the gap fills, so single paths only show as fibres. 0 shows every path.

meshes.label: Meshes
meshes.description: Meshes added as they are, like the plates of lamellae. Each one is its own group, after the groups of the paths.
